title: Solve the Bellman equation exactly
brief: Solve (I - gamma P_pi) V = r_pi for a policy's values on the hallway MDP, then turn state values into action values and check that they average back.
hints: Solve, don't invert: np.linalg.solve(np.eye(S) - mdp.gamma * P_pi, r_pi).
Solving with P_pi.T answers a different question. The unknown V multiplies P_pi from the left of the vector, so use P_pi as it is.
mdp.P @ v has shape (S, A): entry [s, a] is the expected next-state value. Add mdp.R and scale by gamma for Q, then set the terminal rows to zero.
